content_items_media_has_asset.name: content_items_media_has_asset
content_items_media_has_asset.value: "content_items"."kind" NOT IN ('audio', 'video') OR "content_items"."media_asset_id" IS NOT NULL

content_items_published_media_has_transc.name: content_items_published_media_has_transcript
content_items_published_media_has_transc.value: "content_items"."kind" NOT IN ('audio', 'video') OR "content_items"."status" = 'draft' OR "content_items"."transcript" IS NOT NULL

assessment_attempts_score_range.name: assessment_attempts_score_range
assessment_attempts_score_range.value: "assessment_attempts"."score_raw" IS NULL OR ("assessment_attempts"."score_max" IS NOT NULL AND "assessment_attempts"."score_raw" BETWEEN 0 AND "assessment_attempts"."score_max")

moderation_batches_closed_fields.name: moderation_batches_closed_fields
moderation_batches_closed_fields.value: ("moderation_batches"."status" = 'closed') = ("moderation_batches"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "moderation_batches"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL)
